items.name: Rusty Sword
items.description: A nicked blade carried on the road to Stillbarrow.

items.name: Notched Greataxe
items.description: A two-handed axe from a barrow skirmish. It hits hard and leaves the wielder open.

items.name: Oak Shield
items.description: A light shield of banded oak.

items.name: Oathkeeper's Plate
items.description: Plate kept for the oathkeepers of the Stillbarrow. It turns a blow and slows a step.

items.name: Wolfhide Charm
items.description: A twist of wolfhide. The step comes easier.

items.name: Minor Potion
items.description: A bitter draught that knits a wound.

items.name: Focus Tonic
items.description: A sharp sip that steadies the mind.
